---
title: "Distribution"
---

This page captures the repo's distribution and publishing paths.

## Python Package

- Package name target: `ts-agents`
- Build backend: `setuptools`
- Build command:

```bash
uv build
```

Publishing automation lives in `.github/workflows/publish-pypi.yml`.

The workflow is designed for GitHub Actions -> PyPI trusted publishing and runs
on version tags (`v*`) or manual dispatch.

Optional TestPyPI validation lives in `.github/workflows/publish-testpypi.yml`.
It is a separate build/publication and does not establish byte identity with a
later PyPI build.

## GitHub Release Flow

Release tags use the form `vX.Y.Z`.

Recommended release steps:

1. update `CHANGELOG.md`
2. merge the release changes and synchronize a clean source revision
3. install the locked test profile with `uv sync --frozen --all-extras` on Python 3.11-3.13
4. run `bash scripts/check_release_quality.sh` and `uv run --no-sync python -m pytest -q`
5. build into a fresh directory with `uv build --out-dir /tmp/ts-agents-release-dist`
6. check metadata with `uv tool run twine check /tmp/ts-agents-release-dist/*`
7. run `python scripts/verify_release_artifacts.py --dist-dir /tmp/ts-agents-release-dist --report /tmp/artifact-verification.json`
8. run `bash scripts/smoke_install_wheel.sh <python-version> /tmp/ts-agents-release-dist` on Python 3.11-3.14 and rebuild/install from an extracted, Git-free sdist
9. record the commit/tree, source digest, commands, environment, test counts, and qualification limits
10. push an annotated version tag targeting that revision
11. let `publish-pypi.yml` qualify the tagged source, build once, verify contents, smoke-install those artifacts, and publish those same artifacts
12. download the workflow distributions, compare PyPI downloads against their hashes, and create a GitHub release with the distributions, checksums, and qualification evidence

The base install is qualified on Python 3.11-3.14. Full tests use the locked
optional dependency stack on 3.11-3.13. Background jobs require POSIX
(Linux/macOS or WSL); Linux is the CI qualification platform. Remote sandbox
termination, native Windows background jobs, real LLM adapters, and browser UI
behavior are outside this release qualification.

## Sandbox Container Image

The sandbox container is built from `Dockerfile.sandbox`.

- Local build:

```bash
./build_docker_sandbox.sh
```

- Published image target:

```text
ghcr.io/fnauman/ts-agents-sandbox
```

Automation lives in `.github/workflows/publish-sandbox-image.yml`.

The published image is intended to give users a prebuilt sandbox backend instead
of requiring a local Docker build before first use.

## Notes

- CI smoke-tests the base wheel on Python 3.11-3.14 outside the checkout, including
  discovery, skills, workflows, autoresearch, run catalogs, and job completion.
- CI also runs a narrow `ruff` + `mypy` quality gate over the release/package
  surface.
- The publish workflow also gates real PyPI publishing on the same artifact
  smoke matrix.
- Locked-stack tests and fresh base dependency resolution cover different
  environments. Neither establishes compatibility with every declared minimum.
- Retain source identity, workflow logs, and artifact hashes with each release.
  GitHub/PyPI publication must be verified by downloading the artifacts.
